statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: If some Configuration Options received in a Configure-Request are not recognizable or are not acceptable for negotiation (as configured by a network administrator), then the implementation MUST transmit a Configure-Reject.
actions: transmit Configure-Reject containing only the unacceptable Configuration Options from the Configure-Request

statements.subject: message
statements.description: All recognizable and negotiable Configuration Options are filtered out of the Configure-Reject, but otherwise the Configuration Options MUST NOT be reordered or modified in any way.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: On reception of a Configure-Reject, the Identifier field MUST match that of the last transmitted Configure-Request.
actions: validate Identifier field against last transmitted Configure-Request identifier
silently discard Configure-Reject if Identifier does not match

statements.subject: message
statements.description: Additionally, the Configuration Options in a Configure-Reject MUST be a proper subset of those in the last transmitted Configure-Request.
actions: validate Configure-Reject options are a proper subset of last transmitted Configure-Request options
silently discard Configure-Reject if options are not a proper subset

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Reception of a valid Configure-Reject indicates that when a new Configure-Request is sent, it MUST NOT include any of the Configuration Options listed in the Configure-Reject.
actions: remove all Configure-Reject options from the options set used in the next Configure-Request
